description: This file implements authentication-related API endpoints for a web backend, including user registration, login, profile retrieval, profile update, and token refresh using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: register_user(user_data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user, hashes the password, checks for existing email/username, creates user in DB, and returns a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: login_user(login_data: UserLogin, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying email and password, then returns a JWT token with user info.

methods.name: get_current_user_profile( current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: update_current_user_profile( user_update: UserUpdate, current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates profile information for the current authenticated user.

methods.name: refresh_access_token( current_user: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Generates a new access token for an authenticated user.
